subject: Bootcamp bridge funding for LeafLabs cohort — credit extension & staged release

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leaflabs.ai>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@cf-integrations.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bootcamp promo credit bridge for May cohort

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the intro last week — LeafLabs is excited to run our second developer bootcamp in late June. We hit the token allocation limit in the last cohort and had to pause a few hands-on exercises; we want to avoid that this time.

Can Redwood provide an emergency bridge of promotional credits (approx. $8k worth) to cover the first two weeks of the cohort while our procurement completes? We can supply a signed SOW and an early invoice to trigger the co-funding. CloudFoundry Integrations (copied) will manage the onboarding for their SI-led labs.

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf (draft), budget_breakdown.xlsx

High level ask:
- $8,000 in trial credits allocated to LeafLabs account: leaflabs-prod@leaflabs.ai
- Staged release: $4k up front, $4k released after onboarding completion and first workshop
- Extension window: credits valid for 90 days from activation

We understand approval may require an exception; appreciate any expedited help.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Developer Relations
LeafLabs

Forwarding LeafLabs request — immediate ask for $8k bridge with staged release. They attached a draft SOW and budget. CloudFoundry SI will run the labs (ops@cf-integrations.com).

Quick notes:
- This looks like a classic co-funded bootcamp pilot; PR/credits runbook normally allows up to $10k for accelerator partners with approval.
- We need a signed SOW, legal OK on the staged release language, and confirmation that LeafLabs is an active marketplace listing (they are listed, but need proof of active onboarding).

Can one of you pick this up? If ops wants to release $4k now, we should create a conditional credit ledger entry tied to the SOW milestone.

Rafael
